calibration_note: Ranks of connections that passed formal review. Reviewed structural links typically rank far below the top candidates: low similarity is not evidence of no convergence.
known_false_positive_patterns: Shared vocabulary with different formal objects: 'clock' in CL (pair-event epoch, a projection) and GT (continuous vs jump time) - see X::0003
Shared vocabulary from inherited method text (scope boilerplate, 'W4', 'exact') under the common 8G lineage
Numbers and family names matching without a shared estimand

method.documents_selected: every source_finding, formal_claim and source_question statement of the pinned CL and GT sources (SC documents excluded: catalogued only)
method.duplicate_handling: greedy near-duplicate clustering within each source (cosine >= 0.9); at most 2 candidates per cluster pair
method.tokeniser: lowercase [a-z][a-z0-9-]+, stop-words removed, length > 2, then the declared synonym table
method.weighting: sublinear tf times smoothed idf over the CL+GT statement corpus

score_meaning: TF-IDF cosine between statement texts. A ranking aid for human review: not a probability, not a confidence in correctness, not evidence of structural convergence; a low value is not evidence against it.
